title: ReportFile
description: The close-out report system (docs/specs/ux-spec.md section 4): which sentence belongs to which causal-log entry, how the departments are named, what each cause family recommends and the frame of the two documents. Every text is a string key into content/strings, so each sentence carries its own fact entry.

cupGrams.description: Grams of alcohol in one standard cup (fact-check 29); a drink is worded in cups and in grams.

fallback.description: String key of the sentence for a fact that has no template. Placeholders: {D}, {dept}, {label}.

scopes.description: The parts of the body a sentence can be about, by scope id (a floor).

themes.description: Cause families, each with the handbook page and the advice a report of that family ends with.

themeOrder.description: Which family wins a tie, first first.

defaultTheme.description: The family of a report none of whose sentences belongs to one.

nodes.description: Causal-log entries that have a sentence under another key, as "<kind>:<key>" to a bank key. An entry not listed here is looked up under its own "<kind>:<key>".

ignore.description: Causal-log entries that need no sentence of their own, as "<kind>:<key>"; a trailing * matches a prefix. Anything neither listed nor in the bank is worded by the fallback and counted.

dept.description: String key of the department's formal name (ux-spec 4.4).

symptom.description: String key of what the department says when its light is on.

theme.description: Cause family a strike of this department belongs to.

education.description: String keys of the handbook paragraphs quoted as the health-education point; the notice quotes the first.

situation.description: String key: the host's state at the emergency room, in conservative words.

action.description: String key: one thing the player can do.

sign.description: String key: a reminder about the warning signs, or the closing joke.

agg.description: How the values of a merged sentence combine.

numeral.description: Write the value in Chinese numerals (a count) instead of digits.

score.description: Weight class when a report has too many sentences (ux-spec 4.6): choice 5, warning 4, tag 3, external 2, effect 1.

period.description: Name the part of the day (morning, noon, ...) after the date.

theme.description: Cause family it counts toward; a sentence about a department takes the department's.

vars.description: Data the sentence uses besides the built-in placeholders, and how a merged sentence combines it.

single.description: String keys of the variants for one day: {D}, {h}, {dept} and the vars.

run.description: Variants for the same key on consecutive days: {Dr}, {N}, {dept} and the vars. Absent when the key does not merge.

spread.description: Variants for the same key on days that are not consecutive: the same placeholders as run.

default.description: String keys of the liver's written opinion in an ordinary report.

hangover.description: For a report of the alcohol family, when the liver did not strike.

afterStrike.description: For a report in which the liver struck.

ReportDoc.description: The frame of the two documents, as string keys. The placeholders each may use are fixed in src/core/report/bank.ts.
